story_overview: While Caleb is processed at a police station by Gideon, a text from Julian asks for his dad. Dante, a forensic officer, is then seen with Julian, eventually bringing him to a home where he is embraced by Milo. The story follows Dante's journey to reunite Julian with his family amidst an unfolding investigation.

video_prompts:
Dante: Bald man with a goatee wearing a hooded white forensic garment.
Caleb: Man with long, dark brown hair wearing the forensic suit.
Gideon: Man wearing a plaid blazer over a grey sweater.
Chloe: Woman with long curly hair that includes a blonde hair extension, wearing a patterned robe.
The Holding Cell: Sterile police station cell with tiled surfaces, dark metal bars, and a built-in bench.
the forensic suit: White, full-body forensic coveralls made of a lightweight synthetic material, featuring an integrated hood, a zipper down the front torso, and elasticated wrist and ankle cuffs.
the police clipboard: Standard brown hardboard clipboard with a stack of white papers secured by a large, silver-colored metal clip at the top.
the text message from Julian: Digital text message graphic with the sender labeled 'Julian' and the message text 'Dad where r u?'.

At a police custody desk outside The Holding Cell, Gideon writes on the police clipboard while processing Caleb, who is wearing the forensic suit. Dante glances between Gideon and Caleb as Chloe watches from the background, her expression shifting to one of worry. The text message from Julian is overlaid on the shot.
